articles.title: DSV shares surge on third-quarter revenue beat, share buyback launch
articles.summary: Investing.com -- DSV shares jumped nearly 8% in early Copenhagen trading Wednesday after the company reported better-than-expected third-quarter revenue and announced a 1.5 billion crown share buyback program, first since its acquisition of Schenker.

articles.title: DSV (CPSE:DSV) Faces Airfreight Margin Risk From AI Demand And Fuel Costs
articles.summary: DSV (CPSE:DSV) is flagging potential pressure on its airfreight arm as peak season demand collides with tight capacity in late 2026. Management sees AI infrastructure shippers as a key driver of sustained air cargo bookings that could crowd out other customers. Surging jet fuel prices are adding cost pressure to DSV's airfreight operations and raising questions about future pricing power. articles.title: J.P. Morgan cuts DSV forecasts as Road division woes deepen
articles.summary: Investing.com -- J.P. Morgan cut freight forwarder DSV to "neutral" from "overweight" and lowered its price target to DKK 1,400 from DKK 2,165, saying the company’s Road division will lose more gross profit than the broker had expected.
